integrations_chatCameraLoopChatCameraPer.en: No camera access. Allow LOOP to use the camera in system settings, then try again.
integrations_chatCameraLoopChatCameraPer.zh: 没有相机权限，去系统设置里允许 LOOP 使用相机后再试

integrations_chatCameraLoopChatCameraUna.en: The camera didn't take a photo, so nothing was added.
integrations_chatCameraLoopChatCameraUna.zh: 相机没有拍成照片，这次没有加进来。

integrations_chatImageAttachmentsLoopCha.zh: 第 {page} 张 / 共 {total} 张

integrations_chatImageComposerIf.en: This device is offline. The image wasn't uploaded and the message wasn't sent.
integrations_chatImageComposerIf.zh: 设备当前离线，图片没有上传，这条消息也没有发出去。

integrations_chatImageComposerIf2.en: The server rejected this image upload. The message wasn't sent.
integrations_chatImageComposerIf2.zh: 服务端拒绝了这次图片上传，这条消息没有发出去。

integrations_chatImageComposerIf3.en: The image didn't upload. The message wasn't sent.
integrations_chatImageComposerIf3.zh: 图片没有上传成功，这条消息没有发出去。

integrations_chatImagePolicyNotAnImage.en: Only images can be sent here. What you picked isn't an image, so it wasn't added.
integrations_chatImagePolicyNotAnImage.zh: 这里只能发图片，刚才选的不是图片，没有加进来。

integrations_chatImagePolicyTooLarge.en: Each image must be 10 MB or less. The larger one wasn't added.
integrations_chatImagePolicyTooLarge.zh: 单张图片不能超过 10 MB，超出的那张没有加进来。

integrations_chatImagePolicyTooMany.en: A message can have up to 9 images. The extra ones weren't added.
integrations_chatImagePolicyTooMany.zh: 一条消息最多 9 张图片，多出来的没有加进来。

integrations_chatImagePolicyUnsupportedF.en: Only JPG, PNG, WebP and GIF images are supported. Other formats weren't added.
integrations_chatImagePolicyUnsupportedF.zh: 只支持 JPG、PNG、WebP、GIF 四种图片，其他格式没有加进来。

integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.en: The wallet returned a duplicate sign-in request. Reconnect.
integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.zh: 钱包返回了重复的登录请求，请重新连接。

integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.en: The address, message or signature from the wallet doesn't match this sign-in request.
integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.zh: 钱包返回的地址、消息或签名与本次登录请求不匹配。

integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.en: No current Privy account. The wallet wasn't linked.
integrations_externalWalletCredentialGat.zh: 缺少当前 Privy 账号，钱包未绑定。

integrations_memoryCommunityGatewaysDesc.en: A sample community in development preview. Member counts and roles are local in-memory values.
integrations_memoryCommunityGatewaysDesc.zh: 开发预览中的示例社区，成员数与角色都是本地内存值。

integrations_memoryCommunityGatewaysReje.en: Demo data: this name duplicates a live community. Pick another and resubmit.
integrations_memoryCommunityGatewaysReje.zh: 演示数据：社区名称与已上线社区重复，请换一个再提交。

integrations_memoryCommunityGatewaysTitl.zh: 演示公告 · 本周路线图
演示公告 · 周四语音房

integrations_memoryLiveVoiceRoomsTitle.zh: 开发预览 · 周五 AMA

integrations_memoryPublicProfilesBio.en: Development preview account. Profile and holdings are demo data.
integrations_memoryPublicProfilesBio.zh: 开发预览账号，资料与持仓都是演示数据。

integrations_networkProbeName2.zh: LOOP 服务 · 能力清单

integrations_networkProbePurpose2.en: Two requests in a row, the second is recorded (reused connection)
integrations_networkProbePurpose2.zh: 连续请求两次，记第二次（复用连接）

integrations_networkProbePurpose7.en: Reference only; the app doesn't connect to nodes directly
integrations_networkProbePurpose7.zh: 仅供参考，应用不直接连接节点

integrations_networkProbePurpose8.en: Baseline for DNS and secure connections
integrations_networkProbePurpose8.zh: 域名解析与安全连接的对照

integrations_privyAuthGatewayAuthenticat.en: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayAuthenticat.zh: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayExternalWal.en: This wallet is linked to another LOOP account. Sign in to that account and unlink it first, then come back to link it.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayExternalWal.zh: 这个钱包已绑定在另一个 LOOP 账号上。请先用那个账号登录并解绑，再回来绑定。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayLoopUndecid.en: Can't confirm your sign-in right now. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayLoopUndecid.zh: 暂时无法确认登录状态，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayMessage.en: The Privy App Client ID isn't configured, so real sign-in isn't available.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayMessage.zh: Privy App Client ID 尚未配置，真实登录暂不可用。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayNetwork.en: Can't confirm your sign-in right now. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayNetwork.zh: 暂时无法确认登录状态，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayOauthFailur.en: {label} sign-in can't reach the network. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayOauthFailur.zh: {label} 登录网络不可用，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayOauthFailur.en: {label} sign-in couldn't return to the app. Check the app configuration and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayOauthFailur.zh: {label} 登录回跳失败，请检查应用配置后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 验证码发送失败，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Invalid wallet address. Nothing was unlinked.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 钱包地址无效，没有解绑。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: The account changed. Refresh to check whether the wallet was unlinked.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 账号已变化，请刷新后确认钱包是否已解绑。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Unlinking didn't finish. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 解绑没有完成，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: The previous account's wallet action is still finishing. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 上一账号的钱包操作仍在结束，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Wallet creation isn't confirmed. Refresh and try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 钱包创建状态未确认，请稍后刷新重试。
请先完成 Privy 登录。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Can't reach the sign-in service right now. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 暂时无法连接登录服务，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Your sign-in credential has expired. Try again.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 登录凭证已失效，请重新尝试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Couldn't sign out. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 退出登录失败，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: The code is invalid or has expired. Check it again.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 验证码无效或已过期，请重新检查。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Sign-in didn't finish. Check your network and return configuration, then retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 登录未完成，请检查网络和回跳配置后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Privy didn't return a sign-in message to sign. Retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: Privy 未返回可签名的登录消息，请重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Couldn't create the wallet sign-in message. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 无法生成钱包登录消息，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Wallet sign-in didn't finish. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 钱包登录未完成，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: Wallet linking didn't finish. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 钱包绑定未完成，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.en: The account changed and the wallet wasn't unlinked. Try again.
integrations_privyAuthGatewayPrivyGatewa.zh: 账号已变化，钱包没有解绑，请重新尝试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.en: This wallet already belongs to another Privy account. LOOP won't move or delete accounts automatically.
integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.zh: 该钱包已属于另一个 Privy 账号，LOOP 不会自动转移或删除账号。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.en: Couldn't submit the wallet credential. Check your network and retry.
integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.zh: 钱包凭据提交失败，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.en: Privy didn't accept this wallet credential; it may be linked to another account. LOOP won't move or delete accounts automatically.
integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweFailure.zh: Privy 未接受该钱包凭据；它可能已绑定其他账号。LOOP 不会自动转移或删除账号。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweLinkFai.zh: 钱包绑定没有完成，请重试。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweUnlinkF.en: This is the account's only sign-in method and can't be unlinked. Link an email or another sign-in method first.
integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweUnlinkF.zh: 这是账号唯一的登录方式，不能解绑。请先绑定邮箱或其他登录方式。

integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweUnlinkF.en: Unlinking didn't finish. Try again later.
integrations_privyAuthGatewaySiweUnlinkF.zh: 解绑没有完成，请稍后重试。

integrations_privyMfaGatewayReleasedMess.en: LOOP doesn't yet offer a way to enter a code for actions held by two-step verification. This action was cancelled.
integrations_privyMfaGatewayReleasedMess.zh: LOOP 还没有为被二次验证拦住的操作提供输入验证码的入口，这次操作已经取消。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet connection or signature request was rejected.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 已拒绝钱包连接或签名请求。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The Reown Project ID isn't configured, so external wallets aren't available.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: Reown Project ID 尚未配置，外部钱包暂不可用。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: A sign-in or wallet connection is already in progress.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 已有登录或钱包连接操作正在进行。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: This page was closed. Start the wallet connection again.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 当前页面已关闭，请重新发起钱包连接。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The sign-in message is empty. Reconnect the wallet.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 登录消息为空，请重新连接钱包。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet connection or return didn't finish. Go back to LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包连接或回跳未完成，请返回 LOOP 后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Wallet connection cancelled.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 已取消钱包连接。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet picker didn't open. Retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包选择页未能打开，请重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet connection timed out. Go back to LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包连接等待超时，请返回 LOOP 后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: This wallet session didn't authorize personal_sign. Reconnect.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 该钱包会话没有授权 personal_sign，请重新连接。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet didn't return a usable EVM address.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包没有返回可用的 EVM 地址。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Wallet app not found. Install it and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 未找到该钱包 App，请先安装后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Invalid wallet session. Reconnect.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包会话无效，请重新连接。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet signature timed out. Go back to LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包签名等待超时，请返回 LOOP 后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet didn't return a valid signature.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包没有返回有效签名。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Couldn't open the wallet app or return to LOOP. Retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 无法打开钱包 App 或返回 LOOP，请重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet connection can't reach the network. Try again later.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包连接网络不可用，请稍后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The wallet connection or return didn't finish. Retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: 钱包连接或回跳未完成，请重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Reown setup didn't finish. Restart LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: Reown 初始化未完成，请重启 LOOP 后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: Reown setup failed. Restart LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: Reown 初始化失败，请重启 LOOP 后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The Reown service timed out. Check your network and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: Reown 服务连接超时，请检查网络后重试。

integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.en: The Reown service isn't ready. Restart LOOP and retry.
integrations_reownExternalWalletConnecto.zh: Reown 服务尚未就绪，请重启 LOOP 后重试。
